title.en: Amending Certain Sections of Presidential Decree No. 189, as Amended By Presidential Decree No. 564 Otherwise Known as the Charter of the Philippine Tourism Authority

text.en:
Chapter I is hereby amended by adding a new section to read as follows:
"Sec. 12-A. All projects undertaken by the Authority in pursuance of its functions and objectives as
implementing arm of the Department of Tourism in the development and promotion of tourism projects shall
be deemed registered under P.D. 535 and shall enjoy all the incentives and benefits provided therein."

Section 36 is hereby amended by adding a new paragraph to read as follows:
"The above properties including those acquired by the Authority by pursuance, transfer or assignment shall be
exempt from the payment of all taxes of whatever kind and nature imposed by the Republic of the Philippines,
its agencies, instrumentalities or political subdivisions."

Section 37 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 37. All purchase of equipment and supplies or contracts for services except for personnel services,
entered into by the Authority, shall be done through competitive public bidding: Provided, that bidding shall
not be required when (1) an emergency, as certified by the General Manager, requires immediate delivery of
the supplies or performance of the services, and (2) the aggregate amount involved in any one purchase of
supplies or procurement of services does not exceed Two Hundred Thousand Pesos (P200,00), in which case,
such purchase or procurement may be made in the usual course of business: Provided, that the Authority's
emergency purchase of supplies and services shall not exceed the amount of Five Hundred Thousand Pesos
(P500,000.00) for any one month: Provided, further, that purchase of equipment and supplies necessary for the
development and operation of tourism enterprises owned by the Authority and its subsidiaries may be made
directly without need of approval from the Office of the President and other government agencies: Provided,
finally, that in comparing bids and in making awards, the Authority shall consider such factors as the cost and
relative quality and adaptability of supplies or services; the bidder's financial responsibility, skill, experience,
integrity, and ability to furnish repairs and maintenance services; the time of delivery or performance offered;

and the bidder's compliance with the specifications desired."

All acts, decrees, Executive Orders, Administrative Orders, Rules and Regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent with the provisions of this Decree are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This decree shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 28th day of July in the year of Our Lord nineteen hundred and seventy-seven.
